title: Finding and merging duplicate records
when: A list has repeated people, products or entries (after imports or merges) and the user wants them found and combined.
prompt:
Goal: Duplicates found by normalized keys and similarity, merged by explicit rules, with review and an audit list.
Steps:
1. Match keys per entity: email lowercased and trimmed, phone digits with country code, name plus birth date, SKU.
2. Exact pass: group by key in a Map; groups of two or more are duplicates.
3. Near pass: normalize names and addresses, block by postal code or first letters, then score token overlap or edit distance (threshold 0.85).
4. Merge rules per field: newest non empty wins, lists union, the oldest id survives.
5. Log { survivorId, mergedIds, fields } so references can be repointed and merges undone.
6. Ask the user to confirm near duplicates; merge exact ones automatically only if asked.
Quality bar:
- No record lost; every merged id maps to a survivor.
- False merges are rare and reversible.
- Near linear time thanks to blocking.
Pitfalls:
- Comparing every pair on big lists.
- Merging on name alone.
- Foreign keys left pointing at removed ids.
Verify:
- [ ] Normalizers tested.
- [ ] Merge log produced.
- [ ] References repointed.
- [ ] Threshold configurable.
Output: js/dedupe.js with keys, findDuplicates and merge, plus a result report.

examples.input: tenho clientes repetidos com e-mail em maiúsculas e minúsculas
examples.output: email key lowercase trim, 37 groups found, newest phone kept, merge log for undo
